glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 言 (“speech”) + phonetic 忍.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 認 (訁 → 讠 and 忍 → 人). In current form, a phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 讠 (= 言) (“speech”) + phonetic 人.
senses: [rèn] to recognize; to know; to understand; to acknowledge
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 認; s_page_origin explains the simplified 认.
